## Positioning

Taylor-Marriott is a Midlands-based digital studio. The studio designs, builds and grows digital products — not just brochure websites. Work spans marketing sites, brand experiences, software products, client portals and the digital infrastructure that supports them.

Tagline: "We design, build, and grow the digital products your brand deserves."

## Services (detailed)

### Web design & website development
Custom websites for Midlands businesses and national brands. Design-led, performance-focused, accessible and built to convert. Includes marketing sites, portfolio sites, multi-page brand sites and campaign landing pages.

### Digital marketing
Digital presence that supports growth: messaging, landing pages, campaign pages, SEO-friendly site architecture and conversion-focused design. Suitable for businesses investing in inbound marketing across the Midlands.

### Digital infrastructure
Technical foundations for digital products: integrations, APIs, automation, hosting architecture, deployment pipelines and the connective tissue between marketing sites, apps and back-office systems.

### Software & digital product development
Bespoke software, client portals, internal tools, SaaS products and AI-assisted digital product builds. The studio uses modern development practices and can move from prototype to production efficiently.

### UI/UX design
User interface and experience design for websites and digital products.

## Technology & delivery

- Modern web stack (React, Vite, component-driven front ends)
- Netlify and cloud-native deployment patterns
- AI-assisted development for faster delivery without sacrificing quality
- Performance, accessibility and mobile-first design

## Frequently asked questions

**What does Taylor-Marriott do?**
Web design, digital marketing, digital infrastructure and software/digital product development for Midlands and UK businesses.

**Is Taylor-Marriott only for large companies?**
No. The studio works with ambitious brands of different sizes — from local Midlands businesses to national and international clients.

**Does Taylor-Marriott do marketing as well as development?**
Yes. Services include both marketing-focused website work and deeper software/infrastructure builds.

**How do I get a quote?**
Use https://taylor-marriott.com/contact or email hello@taylor-marriott.com with a short project brief.
